label: OPC UA Compact Server - Full Working Example
info:
Complete example wiring together everything from the External Helper Module, Namespace URI, and Bad-quality tag flagging features.

BEFORE DEPLOYING:
1. Copy examples/opcua-blueprint-helper.js to a real path on your system (e.g. /home/pi/.node-red/lib/opcua-blueprint-helper.js on Linux, or C:\Users\<you>\.node-red\lib\opcua-blueprint-helper.js on Windows).
2. Open the 'Example OPC UA Server' node, go to the Address Space Script tab, and set 'External Helper Module' to that real path (it's currently set to a placeholder).
3. Deploy.

What you should see:
- The server node goes green/active, with 'Sessions: X | Folders: 2' status.
- 'Load Master Dictionary' fires once on deploy, publishing a small 2-folder/5-tag blueprint.
- 'Simulate Data' fires every second, updating tag values AND the heartbeat - this is what keeps quality Good.
- Disable the 'Simulate Data' inject node and redeploy to see tags flip to Bad quality after ~10 seconds (the default staleDataThresholdMs) - re-enable and redeploy to see them recover.
- Connect any OPC UA client (e.g. UaExpert, or check_tag_quality.js from this repo) to opc.tcp://localhost:4841 to browse and read the tags directly.
